scope: Final two unreviewed CaliLuke originals in frozen cohort order; prerequisite review only.
linked_reference_caveat: Original bodies read fully as inert text. Package releases, server behavior, public schema inputs and any linked resources remain separate prerequisite checks.

sources.workflow: Use the actual Python ORM to define typed attributes/entities/relations, synchronize schema, perform transactional CRUD and expressions, or invoke its real schema-to-model/DTO generator.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A compatible actual type-bridge package and Python environment, concrete TypeQL schema or model definitions and configuration; real TypeDB and disposable data for database operations. Generator-only work instead requires its actual supported CLI/API and a licensed schema input. Package API and server-version claims need validation against selected releases.
sources.offline_assessment: Actual model/DTO generation may admit a faithful offline task if the real package and reviewed schema are provisioned; no such task is frozen or executed here. CRUD, roles, polymorphism, transactions and persistence require the actual database, not SQLite or self-reported fake results. Generated syntax alone does not establish ORM or database semantics.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Invoke the real selected generator or ORM, inspect generated modules, fields, ownership/role/cardinality metadata and round-trip behavior against the input schema, and run independent actual database transactions for claimed persistence, constraints and rollback. Validate API DTO contracts separately from database correctness.

sources.workflow: Write and debug version-specific TypeQL schema/data operations, graph matching, aggregation and functions against TypeDB, using correct transaction lifecycle and actual observed query results.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A compatible actual TypeDB server and client/console, known target release, actual schema and disposable data, and sufficient read/write/schema permissions. The reference itself marks some illustrated functionality unimplemented for a named release, so snippets and version assertions require actual compatibility checks.
sources.offline_assessment: A provisioned isolated local server can support genuine schema/query/debugging tasks. Syntax drafting, a generic text parser or SQLite translation cannot establish TypeQL execution, cardinality-at-commit, graph/variable semantics or persistence. No server is assumed available and none is contacted during this review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Run actual queries against a seeded isolated database, verify result content/order/cardinality and committed state, test rejected constraints and rollback, and reconcile supported features with the selected release. Preserve errors and incomplete operations; do not treat an unsupported feature or missing server as a measured skill failure.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
